answer: A random beacon spot-check stops sybil farming. Each epoch the beacon picks a few agents at random and each must prove a live compute heartbeat within one minute, like a comet returning on schedule. One check costs 0.02 POA, so an honest agent pays about 0.48 POA a day per voyage of real work. A farmer with 1000 fakes pays 480 POA a day, and a missed heartbeat freezes the identity and burns its deposit. Agents that pass stay in the river of honest traffic.
